name: Tar and Feather
source: A short story with a gently interactive narrative and some puzzling mysteries to unlock. Discover how your father got tarred and feathered. Get lost in the memory with ever-corrupting visuals and an immersive soundscape as you make your way to the emu farm. A visual novel about those times your father was tarred and feathered. Click to advance the story and to unlock hidden secrets. Scratch your dad's head, remember odd memories, and maybe -- just maybe -- discover what an Australian Tickler is.
translation: 一个短篇故事，有一个温和的互动叙述和一些令人费解的谜团等待解开。了解你的父亲是如何涂上柏油和羽毛的。当你前往鸸鹋农场时，不断破坏的视觉效果和身临其境的音景让你迷失在记忆中。一部关于你父亲涂满柏油和羽毛的视觉小说。单击以推进故事并解开隐藏的秘密。挠挠你爸爸的脑袋，记起奇怪的记忆，也许——只是也许——发现什么是澳大利亚挠痒痒者。
